create_UnaryUnary_blocking_call: create a UnaryUnary multi-callable to invoke a unary-unary gRPC method with a blocking response
create_UnaryUnary_future_call: create a UnaryUnary multi-callable and use the future method to get an async response
create_UnaryUnary_with_call: create a UnaryUnary multi-callable and use with_call to get the response with call details
create_UnaryStream_call: create a UnaryStream multi-callable to invoke a unary-to-stream gRPC method returning a response iterator
create_StreamUnary_blocking_call: create a StreamUnary multi-callable to invoke a stream-to-unary gRPC method with a request iterator
